verdict.rationale: Call-recording consent and data retention are a fair question for a voice-agent framework with telephony support, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions call recording, per-call recording toggles, consent or disclosure prompts, or retention settings. Telephony and self-hosting evidence covers different capabilities and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, I can meet call-recording consent and disclosure obligations with per-call recording controls and configurable data retention
